## Validate and handoff

### Validate and compile

* Save generated files.
* Keep generated/hand-edited client code within `structure-and-quality.md` (identifiers English; comments/docs mirror or ask).
* Execute local compile tasks (`dotnet build`, `tsc --noEmit`, `mypy`) to verify zero type mismatches or syntax issues.
* Suggest writing integration tests.

### Handoff

Offer committing the new files via `/commit`.
